description: Localisation des bornes d'accès Wifi public sur la commune de Carpentras is a dataset listed in Open platform of French public data, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by Communauté d'Agglomération Ventoux Comtat Venaissin. Location of public WiFi access points on public roads or in municipal facilities in the municipality of Carpentras. This service is set up by the City of Carpentras with the financial support of the European Union as part of the "WiFi4EU" project. Coverage: Communauté d'Agglomération Ventoux Comtat Venaissin. The portal shows the English title as "Location of public WiFi access points in the municipality of Carpentras" (machine-translated by the portal). The publisher named on the listing is Communauté d'Agglomération Ventoux Comtat Venaissin. Its keywords include haut-reseaux-tres-haut-debit, internet, wifi, service, carpentras, wifi4eu. The listing shows 2 download or service links in GEOJSON. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is as linked on the portal listing (https://www.etalab.gouv.fr/licence-ouverte-open-licence). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support telecommunication coverage and network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-plateforme-ouverte-des-donnees-publiques-francaises.
